title: sec filing / 8 k / six flags | Unknown | Six Flags Entertainment Corporation/NEW 8-K Filing — 2026-04...
summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026, announcing the completion of the sale of six theme parks (Worlds of Fun, Michigan's Adventure, Valleyfair, Six Flags Great Escape, Schlitterbahn Waterpark Galveston, and Six Flags St. Louis) to EPR Properties and EP OPCO WOFR, LLC. The transaction was governed by an Equity Purchase Agreement dated March 5, 2026.
